svg.title: YouSpeed map-bundle coverage in Western Europe
svg.desc: All 51 supported map bundles are shown using official administrative and statistical region boundaries. Coral marks bundles in countries with an embedded on-device traffic-sign-recognition pack.
svg.text: Western Europe · official region boundaries · Web Mercator
Coral = an embedded on-device TSR pack; blue = map bundle coverage.
Boundaries: Eurostat/GISCO NUTS 2013 and country geometry · © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries.
